The '''Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival''' was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] celebration on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to honor the hard work of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and animal handlers after years of conflicts.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=lots|Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival}}</ref>

==History==
In the past [[Standard century/Legends|century]], the citizens of Dantooine began to truly benefit from their farmland, free of the stresses left behind after years of oppression and destruction. As a result, they started the Spring Abundance Festival to celebrate the hard work and sacrifices of farmers and animal handlers. Over the years, the festival grew to such popularity that visitors from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] travel to Dantooine to partake in the bountiful fruits of its citizens' labor.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=lots|Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival is an annual event first introduced in [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb" />
